title: Campaign Manager
description:
Integrated Marketing Campaigns Manager - Legal

We're looking for an experienced Integrated Marketing Campaigns Manager to join the marketing function of a leading professional services organisation.

This role is focused on turning business priorities into effective, targeted marketing campaigns. You'll take ownership of campaigns from initial brief through to delivery and evaluation, working with senior stakeholders across different areas of the organisation to ensure activity is well planned, commercially focused and delivers measurable results.

You'll be suited to this role if you enjoy bringing people and projects together, managing multiple moving parts and seeing a campaign develop from an idea into a successful piece of marketing activity.

Previous marketing experience within a law firm is beneficial.

About the role
- Location: Liverpool or Manchester
- Salary: Dependent on experience
- Contract: Permanent
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm
- Working: Flexible/hybrid options available

Key responsibilities
- Plan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns aligned with strategic and commercial priorities.
- Manage campaigns from initial brief and planning through to execution, ensuring deadlines and resources are effectively coordinated.
- Work closely with senior stakeholders across sectors, offices and service areas to develop relevant, targeted campaigns.
- Evaluate campaign performance, using data and insight to demonstrate impact and improve future activity.
- Support marketing activity around new services, business initiatives, growth plans and key organisational priorities.

Key skills & experience
- Proven experience delivering integrated marketing campaigns within a law firm or comparable professional services environment.
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines.
- Confident working with senior stakeholders and translating business objectives into practical marketing activity.
- Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how marketing can support growth and business development.
- Highly organised, collaborative and solutions-focused, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Desirable: CIM or equivalent marketing qualification, experience supporting service launches or growth initiatives, and familiarity with campaign analytics and reporting.

Benefits
- Flexible/hybrid working
- Comprehensive benefits package
- Professional development opportunities
- Collaborative and supportive working environment
- Strong focus on employee wellbeing and inclusion

title: Interim Marketing and Communications Manager
description:

title: Interim Senior Internal Communication Manager
description:

Working closely with senior stakeholders, you will develop and deliver impactful communications campaigns that support organisational transformation, employee engagement and continuous improvement.

Our client is a respected and purpose-led organisation with a strong reputation in its sector. They are seeking an experienced professional to join the team during an exciting period of activity and change, providing the opportunity to make a tangible impact within a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

- Create engaging communication plans and content that simplify complex initiatives for internal audiences.
- Enhance internal engagement channels and identify opportunities to leverage emerging digital communication tools and technologies.
- Provide strategic communications advice and guidance to senior leaders and stakeholders across the organisation.

- Develop clear evaluation frameworks to measure the effectiveness and impact of communication activities.

- Ability to translate complex information into clear, engaging and audience-focused messaging.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Marketing Executive / Manager (part time)
description:
Marketing Executive / Manager

And Serve Limited - Baltic Triangle, Liverpool (office-based)

Part-time, 3 days per week (Tuesday-Thursday or Wednesday-Friday), with potential to grow into a full-time role

£16-£20 per hour, depending on experience

About us

And Serve is a Liverpool-based company that designs, supplies and installs kitchens and bars for restaurants, bars, hotels and venues. Our group also includes Bar Blades, an online shop selling professional bar tools and accessories, and Ice and Easy Rentals, our hospitality rentals brand.

We're a small, ambitious team looking for a hands-on marketer to help grow all three brands.

The role

You'll work directly with the Director and take ownership of marketing for And Serve, Barblades and Iceandeasy. That means running day-to-day content and campaigns and also helping shape the longer-term marketing strategy. The work is varied. One day you might plan a paid social campaign for Barblades, and the next you could represent And Serve at a hospitality networking event.

The role is based at our office in Liverpool's Baltic Triangle. It starts at three days per week, either Tuesday to Thursday or Wednesday to Friday, with clear potential to become full-time as the businesses grow.

Key responsibilities
- Plan, create and schedule social media content across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and TikTok for each brand, and grow engagement and following.
- Produce and send regular email newsletters, manage subscriber lists, and use performance data to improve open and click-through rates.
- Set up, manage and optimise paid digital advertising on Meta, Google Ads and LinkedIn, staying within agreed budgets and reporting on return on spend.
- Plan and deliver offline marketing, including print materials, trade shows, direct mail and industry publications.
- Attend and help organise networking and industry events that build relationships and generate leads for And Serve.
- Keep each brand's tone and visual identity consistent across every channel.
- Track and report on marketing performance, and recommend where to focus time and budget.
- Update website content and product listings when needed, including on Shopify.

About you
- Proven marketing experience, ideally in both B2 B and e-commerce or B2 C.
- Confident running social media, email marketing and paid digital advertising on your own.
- Comfortable with traditional marketing and happy to represent the business face to face at events.
- Organised and self-motivated, able to handle several brands and priorities with little supervision.
- A strong writer with a good eye for design, using Canva, Adobe or similar tools.
- Comfortable with analytics and email tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Klaviyo or Mailchimp.
- Experience in hospitality, catering or events is a real plus, but not essential.

What we offer
- £16-£20 per hour, depending on experience.
- Part-time hours to start (Tue-Thu or Wed-Fri), with a route to full-time. Flexible start and finish times.
- An office in Liverpool's Baltic Triangle, one of the city's most creative business districts.
- Real ownership and influence, working directly with the Director and seeing the results of your work.
- Variety across three brands in different markets.
- The chance to grow your role as the business grows.

title: Marketing Manager (B2B) - Freight Forwarding / Tech - Liverpool (Hybrid)
description:
The Company

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join an established, award-winning logistics and supply chain business with an international presence.

With a strong reputation for innovation, technology and customer service, the business supports clients in navigating the complexities of global trade. As part of its continued commercial development, the company is looking for a Marketing Manager to take ownership of its marketing function and help drive brand awareness, lead generation and business growth.

The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer, you will play a key role in developing and delivering the company's marketing strategy.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused position suited to an experienced B2 B marketing professional who can combine strategic thinking with practical execution across digital marketing, content, PR, events and sales enablement.

You will work closely with the Sales team to deliver targeted campaigns, strengthen the company's market presence and generate measurable commercial results.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and implement marketing strategies and plans aligned with business growth objectives.
- Plan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across digital, email, SEO, social media, PR and traditional channels.
- Collaborate with the Sales team to develop targeted lead-generation campaigns using platforms such as HubSpot and Cognism.
- Manage the marketing project planner and content calendar to ensure effective campaign delivery.
- Create and manage marketing collateral, including brochures, presentations, case studies, digital content and event materials.
- Support exhibitions, networking events and industry conferences.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer insights to identify new opportunities.
- Track campaign performance, KPIs and ROI, making recommendations for continuous improvement.
- Manage relationships with external PR agencies, designers and marketing suppliers.
- Maintain brand consistency across all marketing communications.
- Manage the marketing budget and ensure effective allocation of resources.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in a B2 B marketing role is essential.
- Experience within freight forwarding, logistics or supply chain is highly desirable.
- Proven experience delivering successful multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Strong knowledge of digital marketing, SEO, email marketing, social media and content marketing.
- Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, ideally HubSpot, and lead-generation tools such as Cognism.
- Excellent organisational and project management skills.
- Strong analytical abilities, including measuring and presenting campaign performance.
- Excellent copywriting and communication skills.
- A creative, commercially minded approach with a focus on measurable results.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and marketing analytics tools.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
- Hybrid working arrangement.
- Healthcare plan.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Group Life Assurance.
- Enhanced holiday scheme.
- Cycle to Work programme.
- Gym and lifestyle discounts.
- Loyalty rewards and recognition schemes.
- Award-winning training and development.
- Genuine career progression opportunities.
- Modern, technology-driven working environment.

Apply Now

If you're an experienced B2 B Marketing Manager looking for an opportunity to take ownership of marketing within an established, growing logistics business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now with your CV to be considered for this confidential opportunity.

title: Trade Marketing Manager
description:
Trade Marketing Manager Retail Competitive Salary

We are partnering with an established consumer brand to recruit a Trade Marketing Manager to lead the planning and delivery of campaigns across its wholesale and retail network.

This is a commercially focused marketing role, working across brand, retail, wholesale and digital channels to bring campaigns, product launches and seasonal activity to life. The Trade Marketing Manager will play an important role in strengthening retail presence, supporting wholesale partners and ensuring customers experience a consistent and engaging brand proposition across every touchpoint.

The role would suit a creative and commercially minded marketer who understands how brands operate in a retail environment and can take campaigns from strategy and planning through to execution and measurement.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver trade marketing plans aligned to wider brand and commercial objectives.
- Lead integrated campaigns across wholesale, retail and digital channels, from initial concept through to execution.
- Work closely with wholesale partners to develop effective retail marketing activity that drives visibility, engagement and sales.
- Plan and deliver seasonal campaigns, product launches and key commercial initiatives.
- Develop and manage retail marketing assets including POS, in-store displays, promotional materials and digital content.
- Partner with internal teams across Brand, Ecommerce, Sales and Product to ensure campaigns are aligned and delivered effectively.
- Support the development of customer-facing content across social media, email and other digital channels.
- Use customer, market and competitor insight to identify opportunities and inform campaign planning.
- Manage campaign timelines, budgets, agencies and external partners where required.
- Monitor campaign performance and commercial results, using data and insight to identify opportunities for optimisation.
- Ensure all trade marketing activity is delivered consistently and in line with brand guidelines.
- Keep up to date with retail, consumer and marketing trends to identify new opportunities for the brand and its retail partners.

Key Requirements
- Proven experience in trade marketing, retail marketing or a closely related consumer marketing role.
- Experience working within a retail, consumer, wholesale or D2 C environment.
- Strong understanding of the retail customer journey and how marketing activity can influence awareness, engagement and sales.
- Experience delivering integrated campaigns across physical and digital channels.
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
- Commercially aware, with confidence using campaign and sales data to assess performance and make recommendations.
- Experience working with wholesale partners, retailers, agencies or external stakeholders would be beneficial.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels including social media, email and online content.
- Creative thinker who can develop ideas but is equally comfortable managing the detail required to deliver them.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Highly organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
- A degree in Marketing, Business or a related discipline would be beneficial, although relevant industry experience will be equally valued.

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced Trade Marketing Manager to take ownership of a broad retail marketing remit, working across campaigns, launches, wholesale partnerships and customer engagement within an established consumer business.

If you are a commercially minded Trade Marketing Manager who enjoys combining creative campaign development with hands-on delivery and measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.
